name: STARLIGHT Earbuds Silver
description: Sculptural silver stars with pink centre accents give STARLIGHT a playful, jewellery-inspired finish.
fullDescription: STARLIGHT develops ECHO's star motif through a softer use of colour. Curved silver earpieces frame pointed star-shaped fronts, with pink accents creating a small focal point at the centre of each design. The contrast between the silver surfaces and pale pink details gives the earbuds an ornamental character. The silver-and-pink colourway connects the collection's futuristic silhouette with a playful jewellery influence.
